simulation: Actual production stepMatch loop. A single setup action initializes the existing layup-reverse shot state on a one-player diagnostic match because courtY=90 is outside queueShot close-range criteria. Track injected into served animation module in-page only; no production files changed.
grid: Post-release trajectory checkpoints plus score/dead-ball completion for both facings × 100%/120%
captureMethod: Jam Stage starts from the normal roster, then a one-time diagnostic fixture keeps only Leo in frame and initializes the production layup-reverse shot action. Production stepMatch advances animation, takeoff, carried-ball track, release, shot physics, rim/score resolution, and completion continuously. No manual per-tick ball teleporting; no pause overlay; no ball baked into art.
fixture: One-player diagnostic match at x=100,y=90 with action setup; same production stepMatch path then runs until score/ball completion (maximum 150 simulation steps).
setupFixture: One-time diagnostic fixture on the current Jam Stage: single Leo at court x=100,y=90 with the production layup-reverse shot action initialized. Production stepMatch owns subsequent animation, elevation, ball, release, and flight updates.
